create_IN1K_dataset: create an IN1K dataset instance with a root path and train split for ImageNet 1K
build_IN1K_with_transform: build an IN1K dataset with a custom transform applied to each loaded image
test_IN1K_getitem: test the IN1K dataset __getitem__ method to load and transform an image by index
review_IN1K_get_dataset: review the IN1K get_dataset method that indexes and caches ImageNet files from ImageFolder or DevKit format
summarize_IN1K_class_attributes: summarize the IN1K class attributes including NUM_CLASSES, MEAN, STD, EIG_VALS, and EIG_VECS constants
